P01.rationale: A large, full-bleed portrait of the founder dominates the upper half of the page, serving as the clear human anchor.

P05.rationale: No case study client portraits are present; the page contains no named client images at any size.

P07.rationale: There is no press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial block anywhere on the page.

P10.rationale: No oversized ghost numerals or large decorative quote glyphs are used as typographic ornaments.

P11.rationale: Bold stat callouts ('100+' and '30-50%') are present but there are no charts, before/after visuals, or cost-math diagrams—just raw numbers in a box.

P12.rationale: The upper half is well-filled with the portrait and stat card, and the lower half has a large headline and bullet list, but the mid-section has a noticeable empty gap between the photo and the headline block.

P13.rationale: The full-bleed dark atmospheric photo provides strong background texture in the upper zone, though the lower section sits on a flat dark ground with no additional texture.

P14.rationale: The portrait photo has a dark, moody treatment that keeps the overlaid pill tags and stat card readable, though the scrim is achieved through the photo's natural darkness rather than an explicit overlay.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a specific, named individual (the founder) in a professional setting, reducing generic stock feel, though the pose and lighting are somewhat studio-generic.

N08.rationale: There is a large, purposeless dead zone between the bottom of the photo and the start of the headline block that creates an uncomfortable empty gap.

N10.rationale: The pill-tag labels sit directly on the photo but the dark background behind them keeps them legible; the stat card has a semi-transparent box, so text-on-photo issues are minor.
